lines.text: The man brought Ezekiel into the outer sanctuary and measured it as forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.
The man measured the room beside the inner sanctuary and called it the Most Holy Place.
Carved cherubim alternated with palm trees, and each cherub had the face of a man and the face of an eagle.
The priests who approach the LORD eat the most holy offerings, and they must leave their ministering garments behind before entering the outer court.
The man led Ezekiel out by the north gate and measured the area as five hundred cubits on each side.
